name: 3D Surface Splatting Rasterization
definition: A rasterization algorithm that bins surfels into screen-space tiles, sorts them by depth-interval start, and processes them per-pixel to group overlapping depth intervals into surface layers, accumulating weighted contributions and finalizing layers when gaps are detected.
summary: 3D Surface Splatting Rasterization renders oriented surfels into 2D images by grouping them into depth-interval layers to correctly handle self-occlusion and arbitrary surface layers per pixel.
